points.description: States that corners/interest points improve image segmentation.
States that corners help detect edges (more efficiently) / edge detection.
States that corner details improve object classification/recognition.
States that corner detection (e.g. Harris) is used in many computer vision applications.
points.partial_credit: Names a related application such as matching or tracking without general statement.

rubric.notes: Award 0.5 for each of the four ideas: segmentation, edge detection, object classification/recognition, and general computer vision use. Accept clear synonyms (e.g. object recognition for classification). Give 2 marks for all four, or for three clearly stated applications; wrong or unrelated answers earn nothing for that point.
